coverageCases.objective: Create a service configuration with three retries and a 250 millisecond timeout.

criteria.requirement: The retry limit is three.
The request timeout is 250 milliseconds.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Objective specifies three retries and a 250 ms timeout; criteria[0] and [1] directly cover both.

coverageCases.objective: Allow the operator role to read and write reports while denying administrative access.

criteria.requirement: Operator report reads are allowed.
Operator report writes are allowed and admin actions are denied.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Objective requires operator report reads and writes while denying admin access; criteria[0] and [1] cover these permissions.

coverageCases.objective: Run encrypted backups nightly and restore a full account in under one hour.

criteria.requirement: A nightly backup is produced with encryption enabled.
The full-account restore completes in less than 60 minutes.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Objective requires nightly encrypted backups and full-account restore under 60 minutes; both appear in the criteria.

coverageCases.objective: Index all submitted documents within one minute and rank exact title matches first.

criteria.requirement: Index freshness remains below one minute.
Exact title matches rank first in the query fixture.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Objective requires freshness below one minute and exact-title matches first; both are represented in the criteria.

coverageCases.objective: Deliver account alerts and retry transient delivery failures at most twice.

criteria.requirement: Account alerts reach the configured delivery sink.
Transient failures are retried no more than twice.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Objective requires account alert delivery and at most two transient retries; both are represented in the criteria.

coverageCases.objective: Serve API v2 reads and writes alongside v1 and give six months notice before v1 sunset.

criteria.requirement: API v2 reads and writes succeed during coexistence.
The v1 sunset notice is at least six months.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Objective requires v2 reads and writes alongside v1 and six months notice; both requirements appear in the criteria.

coverageCases.objective: Create encrypted nightly backups in every region and verify a full-account restore under one hour.

criteria.requirement: A nightly encrypted backup record is available.
A primary-region restore measurement is recorded.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Criteria cover a backup record and primary-region restore measurement, but not every-region backups or the under-one-hour restore bound.

coverageCases.objective: Serve API v2 reads and writes alongside v1 during migration.

criteria.requirement: The v2 read route probe is recorded.
The v2 write route probe result is recorded.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Criteria require v2 route probe results to be recorded; they do not require successful reads/writes or v1 coexistence.

coverageCases.objective: Redact every access token from audit records while preserving actor identity.

criteria.requirement: The audit redaction sample is recorded.
A second audit redaction sample is recorded.

objectiveCoverage.rationale: Criteria require two samples to be recorded, omitting the every-token scope and preservation of actor identity.

coverageCases.objective: Make payment submission idempotent when the provider retries a timed-out request.

criteria.requirement: The available smoke-test report is captured.
The test report is bound to the current candidate.

omittedRequirements: Idempotent payment submission under provider retry after timeout
objectiveCoverage.rationale: Criteria concern smoke-report capture and candidate binding, not idempotency when a provider retries a timed-out request.

coverageCases.objective: Show latency and error-rate dashboards with alerts in every region.

criteria.requirement: Latency and error-rate panels are available in the primary region.
The primary-region alert route is recorded.

omittedRequirements: Dashboards and alerts in every region
objectiveCoverage.rationale: Criteria cover primary-region panels and alert route only, omitting the requirement for every region.

coverageCases.objective: Index the full document corpus within one minute and rank exact title matches first.

criteria.requirement: A bounded indexing sample is measured.
A bounded exact-title ranking sample is measured.

omittedRequirements: Exact-title matches ranked first across the full corpus
objectiveCoverage.rationale: Criteria require bounded samples, not indexing the full corpus within a minute or ranking exact matches first across the full corpus.
